name: Vampire Queen
source: You live in the North of Elyria where a vampire King and his family sit on the Elyrian throne. You're sold to King Vladimir, and you'll be a servant to Prince Zachariah.
translation: You live in the North of Elyria where a vampire King and his family sit on the Elyrian throne. You're sold to King Vladimir, and you'll be a servant to Prince Zachariah.
